question_results.question: Describe the event of the first revelation received by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). [4 marks]
question_results.student_answer: When the prophet muhammad SAW Went to cave hira to read namaz . When he ended namaz H.jibrail  came and said read The prophet replied i am not the one to read H.jibrail said again read this happend 3 times h.jibrail spueezed prophet muhammad SAW  he ran back home and said khatijah cover me! cover me! Khatijha ra after realising what happend conforted the prophet and said u are a kind and genourous man allah is always with you he would never leave you alone then she took the prophet to a preist the preist after realising what happend was shocked and told prophet that it was a sign or prophethood/revilation. and this was the 1 revilation
question_results.correct_answer: The Prophet (pbuh) was meditating in the Cave of Hira when Angel Jibrail appeared and commanded him to "Iqra" (Read/Recite). The Prophet replied he could not read. The Angel embraced him three times. Then revealed the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq. The Prophet returned home trembling and was comforted by his wife Khadija (RA) who took him to Warqa bin Naufil.
